# Feature Specification: A feature whose delta requirement is malformed

The delta's own requirements are what become permanent, so they are held to the
same shape as anything already in a living spec.

## ADDED Requirements

<!-- capability: spec-shape-target -->

### A rule whose scenario never says what happens

It MUST do the new thing.

#### Scenario: no outcome is stated
- **WHEN** the thing is asked for

### A rule with no scenario at all

It MUST do the other new thing.
